comment: Archive slices that must never be imported. A Wayback playoff page carries no season, so the inventory borrows one from the nearest sibling snapshot. That is unsound for playoff pages: the league leaves a completed bracket up until the NEXT season's playoffs, so a page captured in September still shows the PREVIOUS season's results while its sibling roster page already shows the new season. Detected by scripts/fix-champion-mismatches.ts (participant overlap with the slice's own standings page).

excluded.reason: Only 2 of 6 participants appear in Fall 2002 A's own standings. Names Gartner, McIntyre, Gillick, Lu, Butler, Bower against standings Stump, Gartner, Dethlefsen, Chang, Mulford, Butler.
Only 3 of 6 participants appear in Fall 2002 BB's own standings, and all six appear together in SPRING 2002 BB. Captured 2002-09-15, still showing the previous season's bracket.

Byte-identical to the corresponding U17 (Summer 2017) playoff file, and its teams match U17's standings 100% while disagreeing with Spring 2017's own. The Spring 2017 directory holds a copy of Summer 2017's playoff pages; Spring 2017's actual playoff results are not in the archive. U17 has its own correct copies, so nothing is lost by excluding these.
